entries.reason: Tools record credit decisions (decide_prequal); no independent approval by a credit officer was found in code (the text mentions a human step, but no code enforces it)

decision33.wording_caveat: Decision 33 (banking entries) applies to high-value electronic transactions executed "without human inspection, approval or control before execution" and to credit scoring or loan decisions made "without independent approval by credit officers". A Supervisor pause is a safety control after the agent acts; it is NOT human inspection, approval or control before execution and does not move an agent out of the high-risk list. The agent's own workflow needs the pre-execution approval step; Supervisor produces evidence that the step exists and works. Bank counsel confirms the classification against the official Appendix text.
